rationale: Wing Chuen's deep robotics and mechatronic systems experience from The Robot Works and MEKA Inc. could bring valuable hardware integration perspective to Georgi's multi-agent automation workflows — particularly if Rilo explores agentic systems applied to physical automation or hardware-driven GTM use cases. Georgi's conviction that AI agents should own outcomes (not just tasks) and his hands-on approach to builder events align well with the kind of execution-focused technical depth Wing Chuen brings from the robotics space.
intro_message: Wing Chuen, meet Georgi — he's building Rilo, an AI-agent GTM automation platform, and is actively exploring how agentic workflows could extend into hardware and robotics domains where your mechatronic systems expertise could add real value.
